title: Puddle Jumping
poem_text:
The rain has stopped, the clouds are gone,
Small puddles shine beneath the sun.
I jump and splash with careful feet,
And feel the coolness on the street.

title: The Quiet Library
poem_text:
Inside the library, calm and still,
Books line shelves from floor to sill.
I choose a story, sit and read,
A peaceful place for thought and need.

title: The Strong Wind
poem_text:
The wind blows hard across the land,
It shakes the trees and moves the sand.
Kites rise high and twist around,
While leaves go dancing on the ground.

title: Morning Sounds
poem_text:
I hear the birds begin to sing,
The soft alarm clock starts to ring.
Footsteps echo down the hall,
A busy morning wakes us all.

title: The Lost Toy
poem_text:
I looked around from room to room,
Beneath the bed, beside the broom.
At last I found it near the chair,
My favorite toy was hiding there.

title: The Night Sky
poem_text:
Stars appear as night grows deep,
While the world begins to sleep.
The moon shines bright above the trees,
Lighting paths with gentle ease.

title: The Busy Market
poem_text:
Voices call from every side,
Fruits and goods are stacked up wide.
People walk and choose with care,
A lively place with sounds to share.

title: The Slow Turtle
poem_text:
A turtle walks at steady pace,
It moves along in its own space.
Though others rush and quickly go,
It takes its time, but still will grow.

title: The Clean Room
poem_text:
I sweep the floor and make my bed,
Put all my books where they are read.
I fold my clothes and wipe the desk,
A tidy room is always best.

title: The Brave Child
poem_text:
I tried a task I feared before,
Though unsure, I tried once more.
With steady hands and heart so strong,
I found the courage all along.

title: The Flowing Stream
poem_text:
A stream runs gently through the land,
It curves and bends like nature planned.
It carries leaves and stones away,
And sings a song both night and day.

title: The Helpful Hand
poem_text:
I saw a friend who dropped a book,
I helped them pick it up with care.
A simple act can make a change,
And kindness grows when we all share.

title: The Changing Weather
poem_text:
Clouds grow dark and hide the sun,
Soon the drops of rain will come.
After storms, the skies turn clear,
And rainbows bright will soon appear.

title: The School Bell
poem_text:
The bell rings loud to start the day,
Students gather right away.
They listen well and do their part,
Learning new things is where they start.

title: The Journey Home
poem_text:
The sun sets low as I walk home,
Through quiet streets I softly roam.
The day is done, my work complete,
I rest at last with tired feet.
